# Formats engine/libc/stdio.c takes (ok) and the ones it calls abort() on (bad),
# one per line after the word and a tab. formats_test.go holds FormatError to
# this file. A libc test in engine/test should run each through vsnprintf with
# arguments of the right types and see whether it aborts, so that a change of
# stdio.c cannot leave the check behind.
ok	plain text
ok	%d
ok	%i
ok	%u
ok	%x
ok	%X
ok	%o
ok	%c
ok	%s
ok	%p
ok	%%
ok	%-d
ok	%+d
ok	% d
ok	%0d
ok	%#x
ok	%-+ 0#d
ok	%5d
ok	%-20s
ok	%*d
ok	%0*d
ok	%+07d
ok	%.3s
ok	%.s
ok	%.0d
ok	%2.0d
ok	%.*s
ok	%*.*s
ok	%hd
ok	%hhd
ok	%ld
ok	%lld
ok	%lu
ok	%llu
ok	%zu
ok	%zd
ok	%jd
ok	%td
ok	%lx
ok	%hhx
ok	%lo
ok	%08x
ok	%8ld
ok	%2147483647d
ok	%.2147483647d
ok	a %s b %d c %%
ok	%s: %s
bad	%f
bad	%F
bad	%e
bad	%E
bad	%g
bad	%G
bad	%a
bad	%A
